request: Estimate Kaggle session risk using measured prediction time; prevent recurrent stale-model/cache problems when loading the next model.

new_session_estimate.type: Rough estimate anchored to last native run plus two unmeasured classifiers and extra correction epoch; not a benchmark.

changes: Run each model operation in a fresh child; preserve separate fit/inference workers and GPU release gate.
Anchor before/after every GPU child to the original session idle snapshot;60second cleanup polling window, not a training time cap.
Parent evicts previous owned HF model directory before the next child imports/tokenizes/loads; worker guard remains.
Delete only owned Xet subcache when changing models; retain same Qwen base for classifier→corrector and inference.
Disable new-Hub shared blob storage when supported; request zero Xet upload shard cache; do not rely on chunk-cache variable alone.
Log free disk and base eviction details; append per-stage start/status/duration to stage_timings.jsonl.
Private inference starts batch8 with persistent8→4→2→1 OOM reduction; development generation stays4, training unchanged.
Ensure failed generation traceback-held activations are released before GC/empty_cache/retry; no repeat oversize attempts everybatch.
cache_ownership: Strict absolute/resolved marker-bound temporary cache only; no user ~/.cache, original weights, adapters, runs or backups are deletion targets. No GPU reset or global process kill.
timeouts: No controller/model training or generation duration caps added. GPU-release cleanup wait is bounded60sec; refuse a dirty transition instead of loading on top of retained memory.
limitations: No guarantee against new-model capacity OOM, driver/other-process memory, download failures or external Kaggle session termination. No tests, native GPU checks or model runs executed per standing request.
preserved: All datasets, frozen candidate, old experiments and three preexisting user-edited docs remain untouched.
